F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that a community celebration
concert will be held on August 9, 2024.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a steering wheel lock giveaway will be held on July
31, 2024; and that the Annual National Night Out event will be held on August 6, 2024.

Mayor Farfan reported that he attended the ICA conference; and provided an update on SB549.
